item.title: Violence flares in Haiti as gang attack kills 30 people

item.title: Ex-Liverpool star Fabinho reunited with Mohamed Salah at Trabzonspor
item.description: Fabinho joined ​Saudi Arabia's Al-Ittihad in 2023, where he won the ​league after his five-year stint at Liverpool.

item.description: Karen Attiah was fired for posts about Charlie Kirk’s assassination that the Post said violated its social media policy.

item.title: Mexico’s Sheinbaum condemns governor’s return amid US drug charges

item.description: Saudi shipping company Bahri confirmed its vessel was struck, all crew members safe.

item.description: Israeli restrictions are disrupting fuel supplies across the occupied West Bank.

item.title: Trump administration seeks to formalise H-1B fee of more than $100,000

item.description: Tehran may count on links with China and others to weather the storm, but average Iranian people will bear the brunt.
